data.name: Sahilraj
data.gender_notes: Sahilraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sahilraj is a combination of two names, Sahil and Raj. Sahil means 'Sun' or 'Moon' in Sanskrit, and Raj means 'King'. This name signifies a powerful and radiant personality, one who commands respect and authority. The name Sahilraj carries the meaning “Sun, Powerful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sahilraj usually hope their child will grow to embody sun, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sahilraj is a name given to children born under the influence of the Sun, Jupiter, or Mars. It is believed that this name imparts strength, courage, and leadership qualities to the child. The name also symbolizes the Sun God, who is considered to be the source of all energy and light.
data.etymology: Sahilraj belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sun, Powerful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sahilraj total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sahilraj carries an aristocratic and royal resonance grounded in Hindu culture. The name Sahil evokes images of celestial bodies, integral to Hindu mythology and astronomy. The name Raj signifies power, leadership, and a regal character, aligning with the values and traditions of Hindu society.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Sahilraj represents a connection to the divine cosmic forces, making it a powerful name. The Sun and Moon, represented by Sahil, are revered in Hinduism as gods, Har Har Mahadev. The name Raj signifies the inner fire or spirit, often equated to the divine self or soul. Collectively, Sahilraj symbolizes rising above mundane influences and embodying the divine within, in the essence of a king.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Sahilraj: Sahil signifies 'happy' or 'joyful' while Raj means 'king'. Together, Sahilraj represents a joyful and contented king, embodying happiness and ruling over one's own domain of life.

historical_references.reference: Sahilraj was a Jain monk and philosopher during the 12th century CE. He was an influential figure in the Digambara sect of Jainism, and is best known for his philosophical work 'Tattvarthasutra'.
Sahilraj was also a prominent Rajput ruler in the 16th century CE, ruling over the kingdom of Jodhpur. He is known for his military prowess and his role in the Battle of Sikar against the Mughals.
